what_it_checks: Sampled CTMC probabilities and post-boundary state use for wall-time MMPP.
derivation: Section 5.2: p = 1 - exp(-dt/tau). For dt/tau = ln(2), p = 1/2. With q = 1/4, P(quiet->active) = (1-q)p = (3/4)(1/2) = 3/8 and P(active->quiet) = qp = (1/4)(1/2) = 1/8. The level denominator is q + (1-q)r = 1/4 + (3/4)3 = 5/2. Thus x_active = r/denom = 3/(5/2) = 6/5 = 1.2. The transition is applied at the boundary, so a quiet state which flips at t=1 uses that x_active on [1,2).
